result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major accessibility/contrast problem in the promotional banner where white text sits on a very light green background, making it hard to read. Other elements (partially visible carousel item and bottom card) are expected scroll/viewport behavior and not defects.

issues.description: In the '3 free deliveries for you' promo banner, the heading and the 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' subtext are rendered in white/near-white on a pale mint-green background, resulting in very low contrast and poor legibility.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker green background or dark text color so the heading and subtext meet WCAG AA contrast ratios (at least 4.5:1 for body text).
